result.title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
result.summary: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Demiurge，一条基于动态 4D 点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染流水线，结合外观扩散模型、记忆一致深度补全、双流 warping 与几何感知精修，实现跨相机轨迹一致的 4D 世界生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「记忆缓存 + 几何一致更新」可看作跨步骤累积状态的更新与漂移抑制机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的长期保存、状态更新一致性提供借鉴线索；但论文面向视频与世界模型生成，与 VLM 推理主线关联间接，需核查。
